It’s a big year for one of American television’s biggest entertainment spectacles as the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade celebrates 100 years of kicking off the holiday season.

But a serious rainstorm and strong wind gusts expected to hit New York City on Thursday could hamper the parade.

The event started as Macy’s Christmas Parade in New York City during the Roaring ‘20s before morphing into the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade.
